definitions.explanation: Describes uncontrollable shaking or trembling, typically of the knees or legs from fear, exhaustion, or cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガク⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{怖|こわ}くて→怖い：00864_kowai⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガク⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガクになった。
examples.english: After the marathon, I was so tired that my knees were wobbling.

notes:
ガクガク is an onomatopoeic word describing involuntary, jerky trembling of joints — especially knees and legs. It implies a coarse, unsteady shaking rather than fine shivering.

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧ (fear)
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧ (exhaustion)
- ⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧ (cold)
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧ (nervousness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガク⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: knees are shaking
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガク⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: legs tremble
- ガクガク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become wobbly/shaky
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ガクガク⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: body is shaking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ブルブル: shivering (from cold or fear, whole-body trembling)
- ガタガタ: rattling, chattering (teeth chattering, objects rattling)
- プルプル: quivering slightly (lighter, sometimes cute nuance)
